descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S03 Existing specs: how many failures before an answer — 0, 1 and 2 Haiku failures, and every attempt failing

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 When the network drops or an AI provider times out mid-dictation or mid-note-generation, the app retries automatically rather than hanging indefinitely; … (UAT OAT-03 step 1; UAT OAT-03 step 2; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; UAT 3.5; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-92568 AC 5)
  • U5 When the primary model (Haiku) is forced to fail or time out, Haiku is retried once, then the same call goes to Mistral (UAT OAT-03 step 6; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 3; TFA-94422 AC 2)
  • U2 If retries are exhausted, an explicit failure message appears (matching the prototype's 'NOTE NOT GENERATED' pattern; EFS: 'Note not generated' shown), never a blank note, a crash, a raw error pop-up … (UAT OAT-03 step 3; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; UAT Empty & Failure States (Note generation failed); TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94422 AC 5; TFA-92568 AC 5)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given chat() with bedrock.invoke stubbed at its seam; Haiku primary, Mistral fallback (row defaults)

When Haiku answers at once; Haiku throttles once then answers; Haiku throttles twice and Mistral answers; Haiku twice and Mistral all throttle; the same with the fallback set to 'none'

Then Calls [Haiku]; [Haiku, Haiku] with no Mistral; [Haiku, Haiku, Mistral] answered by Mistral with fellBackFrom Haiku; [Haiku, Haiku, Mistral] then the error is thrown (so the screen can show a failure); with 'none', [Haiku, Haiku] then thrown

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright api assertions on call order and modelUsage. This is the router every Bedrock text call uses (notes, parsing, assist, voicefix). It shows neither what the physician sees during the retries (S11) nor a slow timeout (S09). The time-based boundaries (a slow Haiku not asked again, each attempt's deadline) are unit tests: S30

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-03/S03
